item.title: iPhone Duo vs Samsung Fold 8 - One-hand mode - similarities and differences between the two foldable flagships
item.description: Apple’s iPhone Duo and Samsung’s Galaxy Z Fold 8 offer different foldable-phone experiences. iPhone’s fixed right-side controls may challenge left-handed users, while Samsung offers more flexible one-handed layouts. Both have 7.6-inch inner displays.

item.title: Top AI adopters in customer service gain over 50% KPI improvements, but value realization remains uneven: EY report
item.description: Organizations realizing the highest value from artificial intelligence (AI) in customer service reported up to 50 per cent or higher improvements across core customer service key performance indicators, according to EY India's latest report.

item.title: Apple charges iPhone 18 Pro users up to 3 times its cost for storage upgrades: What buyers pay
item.description: Apple charges iPhone 18 Pro buyers up to three times its estimated cost for storage upgrades, a Wall Street Journal analysis found. The company reportedly makes an estimated $408 on the 1TB upgrade and $750 on the 2TB variant, highlighting the hefty margins it earns from higher-capacity models.

item.title: Nothing to launch its first AI-native hardware product next month: Here’s what to expect as CEO reveals ‘no new screen’
item.description: Nothing CEO Carl Pei has teased the company’s first AI-native product, a screen-free productivity device whose details remain under wraps. Pei says AI should help people capture useful information from everyday interactions &amp; handle practical tasks, than focus on finding next big consumer gadget.

item.title: Motorola Signature 27 launched: 200MP camera, Gemini AI, 7,000mAh battery and GrapheneOS support — what’s new?
item.description: Motorola has launched the Signature 27 flagship smartphone with a 200MP camera, Gemini AI features, a 12,000-nit display and a 7,000mAh battery. It also offers 100x zoom, GrapheneOS support and seven years of OS upgrades. Global availability is expected in the coming months, starting at $1,599.

item.title: COD Mobile turns 7: What is new as Verdansk returns with Battle Royale upgrades, Mythic Drops and Ford Racing rewards
item.description: Call of Duty: Mobile's Season 10 update marks its seventh anniversary with the return of Verdansk, new Battle Royale features, two Mythic Drops, the Signal 50 sniper rifle and a Ford Racing collaboration offering over 20 rewards.

item.title: ‘Your voice matters’: Sarvam AI CEO Pratyush Kumar offers lifetime access to 70-year-old speech-impaired cancer survivor
item.description: Sarvam AI CEO Pratyush Kumar has offered lifetime access to the company's AI models to 70-year-old oral cancer survivor Raghunath AS after he highlighted the need for affordable text-to-speech technology to help people with speech disabilities communicate independently.

item.title: India focused on becoming AI application capital of the world: Ashwini Vaishnaw
item.description: India is focused on becoming the artificial intelligence (AI) "application capital" of the world, Union Electronics and Information Technology Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said.

item.title: Motorola Signature 27 launched with 7,000mAh battery, 200MP camera and Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6: Price, features
item.description: Motorola Signature 27 has debuted in global markets with a 200MP periscope camera, 7,000mAh battery, Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset and a 12,000-nit AMOLED display. Priced at $1,599 (approximately ₹1.51 lakh), the flagship is expected to launch in India soon.

item.title: Meta, Google and TikTok sue California over new law restricting social media features for teens under 16
item.description: Meta, Google and TikTok have sued California Attorney General Rob Bonta, challenging a new law that restricts autoplay videos and personalised feeds for users under 16. The law, scheduled to take effect in January 2027, could impose fines of up to $50,000 per affected minor for non-compliance.

item.title: Rising memory costs may push mobile prices up 30%, could trigger second-hand device market: Jefferies
item.description: Rising memory costs, driven by growing demand from the artificial intelligence industry, could push prices of low-end smartphones up by around 30 per cent and force consumers to delay fresh purchases or opt for second-hand devices, according to a report by Jefferies.

item.description: GIGABYTE has launched its 40th anniversary ENTER INFINITY India campaign, offering gamers and PC builders Amazon gift vouchers worth up to ₹15,500, AORUS merchandise and GIGABYTE monitors.

item.title: What is Hangang? South Korea unveils a $276 million supercomputer with 614.7 petaflops of computing power
item.description: South Korea has launched Hangang, a $276 million national supercomputer equipped with 8,496 Nvidia GPUs and 614.7 petaflops of computing power. Designed to accelerate AI and scientific research, the system is expected to rank among the world's top 10 supercomputers.

item.title: Sony PS5 trade-in offer: US gamers can get up to $400 for old consoles ahead of GTA 6 launch; check details
item.description: Sony is offering US gamers up to $400 in cash for trading in their old PlayStation 5 consoles through a partnership with refurbished electronics marketplace Back Market, according to TweakTown. The offer could help players upgrade to the $899.99 PS5 Pro ahead of the much-anticipated GTA 6 launch.

item.title: AI moves beyond recommendations to reshape entire shopping experience on e-commerce apps: Report
item.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming the way e-commerce applications personalise the shopping experience, moving beyond conventional product recommendations to potentially influence the entire interface customers see when they open an app, according to an industry report by AppMaker.

item.title: Realme 17T 5G live images reveal redesigned camera module and slimmer bezels ahead of launch
item.description: Realme 17T 5G live images have surfaced online, revealing a redesigned rear camera module and slimmer display bezels ahead of its expected launch. The smartphone is expected to succeed the Realme 16T 5G and join the upcoming Realme 17 series as a more affordable offering.

item.title: 87% of organisations face threat-related incidents, preparedness gaps persist: McKinsey
item.description: Around 87 per cent of organisations experienced at least one threat-related incident in the 24 months preceding a survey, but many remain inadequately prepared to deal with risks beyond conventional cybersecurity, according to a report by McKinsey & Company.

item.title: PS5 console Black Friday deals 2026: Sony announces game discounts, hardware offers remain unconfirmed
item.description: Sony's PlayStation Black Friday Sale 2026 began on November 4, offering up to 75% off thousands of PS5, PS4 and PS VR2 games, with discounts running until November 30. The sale preview includes 16 titles, while deals on PS5 consoles, controllers and other accessories are yet to be announced.

item.title: Dell 14S laptop debuts in India with Intel Core 5, Core 7 processors: Price, features, specifications
item.description: Dell has launched the 14S laptop in India at a starting price of ₹79,990, with four colour options. It features Intel Series 3 Core 5 and Core 7 processors, up to 16GB of RAM, 1TB of storage and a display with up to a 120Hz refresh rate.

item.title: Mahesh Babu invests in Indian gaming startup Shortgun Games: What we know about the deal and its funding history
item.description: Mahesh Babu has acquired a minority stake in Indian gaming studio Shortgun Games for an undisclosed amount. The investment follows its $1 million seed round in 2025 as the company works on a PC and console game targeting global markets.

item.title: MeitY unveils indigenous AI Models EKA-1, Dhīr 2B and 5B under IndiaAI mission
item.description: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) has unveiled three indigenous artificial intelligence foundation models, EKA-1, Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B, developed by domestic companies with support under the IndiaAI Mission, with the government highlighting their potential for specialised applications and deployment in secure, offline environments.
